sets.title: 17 (Side Quests)

sets.title: 23-47 (Ability & Side Quests)
sets.sub: Each level bracket contains multiple quests, only 1 providing the ability you need for your class. The rest are optional quests that provide XP and gear rewards.

quests.name: Fayspire level 17 side quest
quests.guide:
**Quest Name:** Fayspires Lvl 17 Side Quest Walkthrough  
**Level:** 17  
**Class:** All/All  
**NPC:** Adrwyiel Niteshyre  
**Location:** Fayspires  

---

**1.** Talk to **Adrwyiel Niteshyre** in the Wizard Guild — the east building jutting out into the lake. She sends you to kill [**Tesarin Moonstrider (CONs Wht)**](place:877) in the **Sslathis** zone. To find Tesarin Moonstrider, from **Freeport** swim south down the coast. It's a long swim!  
Swim past several (6) zones, including **Hazinak**. Once you pass Hazinak, look for the environmental boundary line (between the desert and the swamps — you will see mountains, too). Follow the boundary line east to the **Sslathis** zone central, turn south, and look for a **black pyramid**, which will be hard to see at night. Tesarin is on top of the black pyramid.  

💡 *Hint:* Ask a wizard to port you to **Sslathis** — the quest mob is standing on the port itself.  
Tesarin is a **Necromancer** and has a **pet (CONs grn)**. Kill, loot, and return to Adrwyiel.  

**2.** Adrwyiel sends you to **Vaelan Wyndsorrow**, located in the **Enchanters Guild** (the west building jutting out into the lake). He wants **600 tunar**. Return to Adrwyiel afterward.  

**3.** Adrwyiel sends you to **Lutherian Doomsinger** for your reward. He is across the room from Adrwyiel.  

---

**Rewards:**  
- **Bards:** Bracers  
- **Clerics:** Bracers  
- **Druids:** Bracers of the Gladestrider  
- **Enchanters:** Bracers of Brilliance  
- **Paladins:** Bracers  
- **Rangers:** Bracers of Nature's Ward  
- **Rogues:** Amulet of the Silent Strider  
- **Wizards:** Robe of Insight  

---

**Note:** Eastern Human Shadow Knights may not be able to receive this quest.

quests.name: Freeport level 17 side quest

steps.text: Talk to Scribe Cathassa. She is in Freeport (FP). From the coach, enter FP through the south gate, enter the long hall, run north, and enter the second west passageway. She is in the building and needs two items:

Embalming Fluid: Kill an Ancient Mummy (CONs blue to yel), which can be found in Northern Ro and Northwestern Ro zones (SW of FP). From FP coach, run SW into the desert. You can always find one near the FP human camp located in Northwestern Ro (SE); head to…
Cured Drakes Blood: Buy from Talya Montar for 600 tunar. Talya can be found in Highpass, on the second floor of the keep, behind the stairs.
Return to Scribe Cathassa. To collect your reward, go to Draeg Kuthra. From Scribe Cathassa, go out the east door, turn south, and enter the first door to the east.

quests.guide:
### **Quest Name:** Freeport Level 17 Side Quest Walkthrough  
**Level:** 17  
**Class:** All/All, Good/Evil  
**NPC:** Scribe Cathassa  
**Location:** Freeport  

---

1. Talk to [**Scribe Cathassa**](place:880). She is in Freeport (FP). From the coach, enter FP through the south gate, enter the long hall, run north, and enter the second west passageway. She is in the building and needs two items:  
- **Embalming Fluid**  
- **Cured Drakes Blood**  

2. **Embalming Fluid:** Kill an [**Ancient Mummy**](place:881) (CONs blue to yel), which can be found in Northern Ro and Northwestern Ro zones (SW of FP). From FP coach, run SW into the desert. You can always find one near the FP human camp located in Northwestern Ro (SE); head towards the hills north of this camp. You may need to kill a few mummies to get the drop you need! Kill, loot, and now go to **Highpass (HP)**.  

3. **Cured Drakes Blood:** Buy from [**Talya Montar**](place:882) for 600 tunar. Talya can be found in Highpass, on the second floor of the keep, behind the stairs.  
*NOTE:* To find HP; go out the north gate of Freeport and follow the Trade Road west to HP. Better yet, ask a lvl 51+ mage to coh you or a 47+ wiz to port you.  

4. Return to [**Scribe Cathassa**](place:880). To collect your reward, go to [**Draeg Kuthra**](place:883). From Scribe Cathassa, go out the east door, turn south, and enter the first door to the east.  

---

**Rewards by Class:**  
- **Bards:** Gloves  
- **Clerics:** Gloves of Radiance  
- **Druids:** Gloves of the Gladestrider  
- **Enchanters:** Bracers of Brilliance  
- **Monks:** Gloves of the Disciple  
- **Necromancers:** Bracers of Shadow  
- **Paladins:** Gloves of Virtue  
- **Rangers:** Gloves of Nature's Ward  
- **Rogues:** Sash of the Silent Strider  
- **Shadowknights:** Bracers of Malice  
- **Shaman:** Spiritrune Gloves  
- **Warriors:** Soldier's Gloves  
- **Wizards:** Pendant of Insight

quests.name: Grobb level 17 side quest

steps.text: Talk to Nungzsh. He is by the well in the blacksmith area of Grobb (the archway near the Froglock prisoners). He needs the liver of a Froglok Questor (CONs Yel). To find the questor, travel north along the road from Grobb until you find a troll war camp. Fr…
Buy sauce from Thuldreksh. He is in a tent in the Shaman's Guild, which is through the door in the huge tree. The sauce costs 600 tunar. Return these two items back to Nungzsh.
Nungzsh sends you to Argash to get your reward. Argash is directly behind the well to the right of Nungzsh.

quests.guide:
### **Quest Name:** Grobb Lvl 17 Side Quest Walkthrough  
**Level:** 17  
**Class:** All/All  
**NPC:** Nungzsh  
**Location:** Grobb  

---

Grobb; Level 17 Quest giver; [**Nungzsh**](place:884) - Evil only by Singz  

1. Talk to [**Nungzsh**](place:884). He is by the well in the blacksmith area of Grobb (the archway near the Froglock prisoners). He needs the **liver of a Froglok Questor** (CONs Yel). To find the questor, travel north along the road from Grobb until you find a troll war camp. Froglok Questor spawns in the marshy areas around this camp, mostly NW and SE of the troll camp. Kill, loot, and return to Grobb.  

2. Buy **sauce** from [**Thuldreksh**](place:885). He is in a tent in the **Shaman's Guild**, which is through the door in the huge tree. The sauce costs **600 tunar**. Return these two items back to [**Nungzsh**](place:884).  

3. [**Nungzsh**](place:884) sends you to [**Argash**](place:886) to get your reward. Argash is directly behind the well to the right of Nungzsh.  

---

**Rewards by Class:**  
- **Clerics:** Helm of Radiance  
- **Necromancers:** Gloves of Shadow  
- **Rogues:** Boots of the Silent Strider  
- **Shadowknights:** Gloves of Malice  
- **Shaman:** Spiritrune Belt  

*NOTE:* The only confirmed Erudite class that can complete this quest is the **Necromancer**. Gnome Rogues can complete this if they are very watchful for KoS trolls.

quests.guide:
### **Quest Name:** Halas Lvl 17 Side Quest Walkthrough  
**Level:** 17  
**Class:** All/All Good  
**NPC:** Olga  
**Location:** Halas  

---

1. Talk to [**Olga**](place:888), who is inside the fort in one of the last huts along the river before you go out to the bank. She sends you to kill [**Bloodmaw**](place:890) (CONs blue), a werewolf, and deliver a letter to **Novak Mcgregor**. To find Bloodmaw, from Moradhim coach, head north along the mountain chain to Goldfeather Eyrie. Search hilly areas NW by the ramps. Kill, loot a fang, then go to **Diren's Hold**.  

2. Give **Olga's Letter** to **Novak Mcgregor** at Diren's Hold, and buy the **cleansing solution** from him for 600 tunar. Directions: from Halas, leave through the tunnel, run east along the river; on the east side is Diren's Hold. From Moradhim, run north along the mountains to a small river, follow it west to Diren's Hold.  

3. [**Undin Kalenn**](place:889) has your reward. From Olga, run along the row of buildings on the east side of town.

quests.name: Hodstock 23: Part One (ability)

steps.text: Talk to Feria Huckert.
Bram D'Lizo wants 1200 tunar. He sends you to kill a Redheaded Bandit (CONS yel-red?? to 23). Kill, loot, return to Feria.
Feria asks you to speak with her daughter, Drew, which rewards you with XP, an item, and a new ability.

quests.guide:
1. [**Talk to Feria Huckert.**](place:916)
To find [**Feria**](place:916), from **FP**, head out the **north gate** and run north to **Hodstock(w)**. She sends you to **Bram D'Lizo**. To find **Bram**, coach to **Fayspires**, from **Fay coach**, head north, swim north across lake, look for a **dock, tower, and a fort area** on the north shores. From the fort, head west, the **Gypsy Camp** is not too far from the fort.

2. [**Bram D'Lizo**](place:917) wants **1200 tunar**. He sends you to kill a **Redheaded Bandit** (CONS yel-red?? to 23). Kill, loot, return to [**Feria**](place:916).

3. [**Feria**](place:916) asks you to speak with her daughter, [**Drew**](place:918), which rewards you with **XP, an item, and a new ability**.

> ⚠️ **NOTE:** You do not have to do the next parts of the quest if you don't want to. There will be no new ability given, just an item and XP.

---

quests.name: Hodstock 23: Part Two

steps.text: Talk to Feria Huckert. She sends you to Freeport to get a Runic Recording from Merchant Yulia (for 1200 tunar). To find Yulia, from the main hall in FP, enter second west door, near the ramps to the Academy of Arcane Sciences guild.
Talk to Bram D'Lizo, use direction given in part one. He tells you to see the statue with the glowing shield. Head north from the bandit fort.
The Statue directs you to Greyvax's caves to kill Iceflesh Zombies. Head northwest from the statue. Drop needed: Tribal Pendant. Return to Feria for rewards.

quests.guide:
> ⚠️ **NOTE:** To do the second part, you must have **good faction with Feria Huckert**. Kill **Cracktooth Orcs** (CONs LB) near **Bobble By The Water**. Return to [**Feria**](place:916) after getting **Feria faction +150**.

1. [**Talk to Feria Huckert.**](place:916) She sends you to **Freeport** to get a **Runic Recording** from [**Merchant Yulia**](place:113) (for 1200 tunar). To find **Yulia**, from the main hall in **FP**, enter **second west door**, near the ramps to the **Academy of Arcane Sciences guild**.

2. [**Talk to Bram D'Lizo**](place:917), use direction given in part one. He tells you to see the **statue with the glowing shield**. Head **north from the bandit fort**.

3. The [**Statue**](place:921) directs you to **Greyvax's caves** to kill **Iceflesh Zombies**. Head **northwest from the statue**. Drop needed: **Tribal Pendant**. Return to [**Feria**](place:916) for rewards.

---

quests.name: Hodstock 23: Part Three

steps.text: Feria sends you to a guard in Freeport named Smitty. He is guarding a door to a building.
Smitty wants 1200 tunar. He sends you to Bison in Everfrost (FreezeBlood Village Zone (NW)). From Halas, go southwest and look for caves in the mountains.
Bison tells you about Greyvax and sends you back to Feria.
Feria wants the remains of Manger MacGray from Greyvax's cave. Find the room with an "Ice Statue". Talk to it, release or not. Receive ice key and open ice chest.

quests.guide:
1. [**Feria**](place:916) sends you to a guard in **Freeport** named **Smitty**. He is guarding a door to a building.

2. **Smitty** wants **1200 tunar**. He sends you to [**Bison**](place:919) in **Everfrost (FreezeBlood Village Zone (NW))**. From **Halas**, go **southwest** and look for **caves in the mountains**.

3. [**Bison**](place:919) tells you about **Greyvax** and sends you back to [**Feria**](place:916).

4. [**Feria**](place:916) wants the remains of **Manger MacGray** from **Greyvax's cave**. Find the room with an **"Ice Statue"**. Talk to it, release or not. Receive **ice key** and open **ice chest**.

> ⚠️ **NOTE:** Rats around the Ice Statue are tough if soloing. Kill rats (no loot), then handle the statue.

3. Return log to [**Grimm**](place:1058).
4. Go to **Guk**, find [**Maerik N'Toxis**](place:1074) in castle bottom of Froglok cave. Use invis; avoid Fungal Elders. Kill placeholders until Maerik spawns (drops 2 scrolls). *Note:* Spawns can take 1-10 hours.
5. Return scrolls to [**Grimm**](place:1058).
6. Go to **Highpass**, find [**Feldink Shortquill**](place:1075) (2nd floor, tower where Lord Voriander is), pay 3000 tunar to translate.
7. Return to [**Grimm**](place:1058), he instructs to reanimate [**Thulite Golem**](place:1077); need **Golem Part A & B** from Golem Protectors.
8. Go to **Tak'Xiv (SW)**. Golem Protectors spawn inside hut on walkway, level 48-49, can't see invis. Pull one at a time.
9. With parts, activate [**Thulite Golem**](place:1077). Level 50, kills player, drops 4 Huge Chunks of Thulite.
10. Return to [**Grimm**](place:1058), reward: XP & class item.

quests.guide:
**NPC:** varies, see below  
**Location:** Forkwatch

---

### 📋 Requirements
Attaining level 30 and completion of your **Level 20 path quest**.

Your level 20 path questgiver advises you to seek a new trainer in Forkwatch to log your level 30 path quest:
- [**Thumgrim Stoutshield**](place:1081) *(in bar opposite coach)*, or
- [**Erilous Skypyre**](place:1082) *(2nd floor, NE corner)*, or
- [**Elowyn Dawnspring**](place:1083) *(2nd floor)*.

**Dwarf & Western Human Paladins:** Speak to [**Sir Arik Lightfire**](place:1084) in Forkwatch. From the coach, head into the big building on your right, go to the very top, and he is standing there with [**Captain Bordengahst**](place:322).

---

After logging the quest, you are sent to [**Crikston Gundlefop**](place:1085) in **Highpass Hold**. To find him: coach to HP, enter the building opposite the coachman, second floor. Crikston wants **three tablets**: **clay**, **stone**, and **bronze**.

> 📝 **NOTE:** If you talk to Crikston again, he will explain the three quests and how to start each. These are essentially **three separate level 30 side quests**.

---

## 🧭 EXPEDITION A
### Runed Clay Tablet
Talk to [**Argot Bittersteel**](place:949) in **Blakedown**. From the **DM coach**, head out the west gate and follow the road south (it will curve west) to Blakedown. Argot is in the first building on your right as you enter town.

He asks you to:
1. Retrieve loot in **Al-Karad's Ruin**, and
2. Kill [**Savage Bear**](place:951).

**Finding Al-Karad's Ruin:** From Argot, follow the road west. At the NW tower at the end of Blakedown, take the road north until it ends, then head due north until the road resumes. Follow it to the ruins.

**Getting the loot:** Enter the ruins, go down the ramp, and head straight to the back room. You will get a popup indicating you obtained the loot. You must kill all mobs encountered. Even with invis, you must kill the two mobs in the loot room. These mobs mostly **CON DB/White@30** and have a **large aggro range**.

**Savage Bear (Polar Bear):** *(CONs White@30)*. The bear roams outside the ruins, usually behind them. Kill it, loot the **Runed Clay Tablet**, and return to Argot.

**Rewards:** 789,086 XP, **Medallion of Fortitude**, and quest progression.  
*Medallion of Fortitude:* 15 STA, 20 HP, 5 AC, 20 DR, Lvl 30, All/All.

---

## 🧭 EXPEDITION B
### Runed Stone Tablet
Talk to [**Two-Eyed Jack**](place:944) in **Trail's End (S)**. From the HP coach, head out the west/south gate and follow the long, winding road to a small village. Jack is in one of the houses.

Jack sends you to find out what happened to **Maximillian Scriber**.

Return to the long road and head north-ish until you reach a cave on your right. Fight into the cave until the [**Silvermist Alpha**](place:955) spawns *(triggered, CONs White@30)*. Kill her and loot **Maximillian's Journal** and the **Runed Stone Tablet**. Return to Jack.

**Rewards:** 394,543 XP, **Two-Eyed Jack's Belt**, and quest progression.  
*Two-Eyed Jack's Belt:* 10 AGI, 10 CHA, 35 POW, 22 AC, Lvl 30, All/All.

---

## 🧭 EXPEDITION C
### Runed Bronze Tablet
Talk to [**Finnus Sodwin**](place:947) at the **Black Swan Inn** (second floor). From the DM coach, head out the west gate and follow the road south; the inn is on the right near a blacksmith area.

Finnus sends you to kill [**Skarr**](place:948) *(CONs Yellow@30)* in **Blackburrow**.

**Finding Blackburrow:** From the DM coach, head out the west gate and follow the road north to the Gnoll Fort. Bypass the fort to the east and continue until you see the tunnel entrance.

**Finding Skarr:** Enter the tunnel, take the first right and go upstairs *(shaman here sees invis)*. Continue through tunnels where more mobs see invis, then go down a cliff and head right. Look for a hidden tunnel leading to a huge cavern. Make the first right, fight *(this mob sees invis)*, move along the small cliff to the right, enter a narrow tunnel. Skarr spawns at the back of this small cavern.

Kill Skarr, loot the **Bronze Headpiece** and the **Runed Bronze Tablet**, and return to Finnus.

**Rewards:** 1,084,993 XP and 3,000 tunar.

---

## ✅ QUEST COMPLETION (Level 30)
You should now have **three (3) tablets** in your inventory. If you lose one, the quest givers will replace it **for free**, but only if you are flagged as having completed the quest.

Return to [**Crikston Gundlefop**](place:1085) to receive a letter. Then return to your starting quest NPC in Forkwatch for your final rewards.

**Final Rewards:** 7,890,859 XP, your **path ability**, and one of the following:
- **Paladin:** Sword of Purity **OR** Hammer of Humility
- **Cleric:** Holy Forgehammer **OR** Benevolent Battlehammer
- **Wizard:** Staff of Tears **OR** Rod of Power
- **Bard:** Rapier of Rapidity **OR** Shimmering Saber

---
---

quests.name: Group 1, Level 40
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Crikston Gundlefop  
**Location:** Highpass Hold

---

### 📋 Requirements
Attaining level 40 and completion of the **Level 30 path quest** from Crikston Gundlefop.

Talk to Crikston in Highpass. He needs **three paraphet rods**. Two are already en route, but you must retrieve the third from [**Twindle Fizzmop**](place:945), located behind the blacksmith in **Freeport**.

Twindle will trade the rod only for the **Sceptre of Tal'Thaz**, found on [**Rauntet**](place:1088) *(CONs White@40)* in an undead valley of **Al'Farak Ruins (C)**, west of the large Nashier camp. The valley is packed with awakened spirits; invis is recommended. Rauntet is a **triggered spawn**. Kill him, loot the scepter, return to Twindle, and pay **3,000 tunar** *(5,000 if you do not haggle)*.

Return to Crikston. As you hand over the scepter, an [**Assassin**](place:1089) *(CONs LB@40)* spawns. Kill it and loot a **Druidic Symbol**.

> 📝 **NOTE:** If you fail to kill the Assassin, speak with Crikston again to respawn it.

Crikston sends you to [**Shiol'Anara**](place:1108) in **Surefall Glade**. She asks you to seek the great bear spirit [**Urisai**](place:1093), but first you must gather:
- The **Bow of Poacher McGee**
- The **Wing of a Jade Drake**
- The **Hide of a Tainted Wolf**

[**Tainted Wolf:**](place:1090) *(CONs White@40)* spawns in **Mariel Village (E)**. Farm until the hide drops.

[**Trapper McGee:**](place:1086) *(CONs Yellow@40)* roams **Surefall Glade**, past and near the lake. Kill and loot his bow.

[**Jade Drake:**](place:1091) *(CONs Yellow to Red)* spawns in **Salisearaneen**. Tough caster. Kill until the wing drops.

Return to Shiol. She sends you to the druid ring in Surefall Glade. Wait ~30 seconds with all items to spawn [**Urisai**](place:1093). He reveals the assassin belongs to the **Night Callers** of the Unkempt North. Return to Crikston.

Crikston then asks you to retrieve an **Examiner Lens** from an [**Evil Eye Examiner**](place:1094) *(CONs Yellow@40)* in **Moss Mouth Cavern (C)**. Take the right tunnel; kill the Evil Eye and its goblin guards, loot the lens, and return.

---

## ✅ QUEST COMPLETION (Level 40)
Speak with Crikston again after a minute. He sends you to your class trainer in Forkwatch.

**Final Rewards:** 14,919,719 XP, your **path ability**, and one of the following:
- **Paladin:** Blade of the Righteous **OR** Hammer of Virtue
- **Cleric:** Hallowed Morningstar **OR** Sacrosanct Warhammer
- **Wizard:** War Wizard's Staff **OR** Wand of War
- **Bard:** Strike of Harmony **OR** Slash of Resonance

---
---

quests.name: Group 1, Level 49
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Crikston Gundlefop  
**Location:** Highpass Hold

---

### 📋 Requirements
Attaining level 49 and completion of the **Level 40 path quest**.

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** Ensure you have plenty of inventory space. Save **everything** NPCs give you until you receive your final rewards and final path ability.

Crikston sends you to [**Anya Spiritdottir**](place:1087) in **Binshore**, south of Wyndhaven along the coast in **Whale's Hill (W)**.

She sends you to [**Halsfur Whitepaw**](place:1095), a barbarian hermit in a glowing blue bear cave in the **Snowblind Plains (NE)**. Bring **5,000 tunar**. Inside, invis is required. In the largest room, find a barely visible ledge on the right wall and follow it back to Halsfur.

Halsfur requires a **Scratched Worm Chitin** and 5,000 tunar. Kill [**Great Worms**](place:1056) *(CONs LB@49)* in **Permafrost (SE–TY Lear)** until it drops. Return to Halsfur for the **Amulet of Protection**, which allows portal entry. Return to Crikston.

---

## 🔐 THE FIRST SEAL (1/4)
Travel to the **Heyokah Burial Ground** in **Spirit Talkers Woods (C)**. From Murnf, run due east to a lake; the portal is a black orb in the center.

> ⚠️ Entering without the amulet causes a **-650 DoT** until death or exit.

Speak to the [**Caretaker**](place:1096) and begin the trial. Defeat [**Eidolon of Malice**](place:1097) *(CONs DB@49)* within the timed event and loot its essence orb. Speak to the Caretaker again to receive **Spiritwalker's Totem**.

Return to Crikston *(1/4 seals)*.

---

## 🔐 THE SECOND SEAL (2/4)
Speak to [**Oransan**](place:1098) downstairs in the Highpass Inn. He sends you to **Salissearaneen (NE)** to defeat [**The Slar**](place:1099) *(CONs White@49)* in the Den of the Grave Wolves. Clear wolves, kill The Slar, loot the **Shield of Orthimius**, and return *(2/4 seals)*.

---

## 🔐 THE THIRD SEAL (3/4)
Go to **Permafrost (N)** and kill [**Frostborn III**](place:1100) *(CONs LB@49)*. Loot his sword, then drive it into the ice throne to spawn [**Frostborn II**](place:1101) *(CONs Yellow@49)*. Kill and loot **Frostcleaver** *(3/4 seals)*.

---

## 🔐 THE FOURTH SEAL (4/4)
Travel to **Anu Village (NE)** at the Unnamed King's castle. Invis inside. Kill [**Tolo Grimsteel**](place:1102) and [**Ganron Lorebane**](place:1103), loot their gems, then summon and defeat the [**Unnamed King**](place:1104) *(CONs Yellow@49)* to loot the **Unnamed Crown** *(4/4 seals)*.

---

## ⚔️ PARATHIOR
Bring all four seals to [**Oransan**](place:1098) in **Snowblind Plains (N)**. He summons [**Parathior**](place:1105). Speak to [**Orinas**](place:1106) (bear form) to choose your Epic weapons, then defeat Parathior and loot an **Ice Chunk**.

---

## 🏁 FINAL QUEST COMPLETION
Return to [**Crikston Gundlefop**](place:1085). He sends you to a class-specific NPC to determine your **Level 49 Path Ability**. Complete the approval visits for your 20, 30, and 40 quests, then return for your final choice.

> 📝 **NOTE:** Bards must seek [**Kaldesh Illinor**](place:1107) in the Freeport tavern.

**Final Rewards:** 45,558,313 XP, your **path ability**, and one of the following:
- **Paladin:** Epic Divinesword **OR** Epic Warhammer
- **Cleric:** Epic Hammer **OR** Epic Mace
- **Wizard:** Epic Rod **OR** Epic Staff
- **Bard:** Epic Rapier x2 **OR** Epic Saber x2

**NPC:** Dixxon Tristar  
**Location:** Castle Lightwolf

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 30  
- Completion of your **Level 20 path quest**

---

### 🗣️ Quest Walkthrough
Talk to [**Dixxon Tristar**](place:1109) in Castle Lightwolf, east of the coachman. He sends you to see [**Deputy Sools**](place:1110), who filed a report about spotting one of the jewels.

[**Deputy Sools**](place:1110) (outside Castle Lightwolf, left tower) sends you to [**Sissy Hasper**](place:1111), who reported seeing a dark drake with a red necklace. She is located in a village in **North Wilderlands (S)**, south/southwest of the castle, in the most southern house.

### 🔴 Red Elemental Necklace
Sissy sends you to kill a [**Dark Drake**](place:1112) (CONs yellow) in **Guardian Forest (SW)**. Kill it, loot the **Red Elemental Necklace**, and return to Deputy Sools.

Deputy Sools then sends you to [**Captain Benta**](place:1113), outside of Halas, who mentions a majestic Freezblood and a white bracelet.

### ⚪ White Elemental Bracelet
Captain Benta sends you to kill a [**Freezblood Majestic**](place:1114) (CONs yellow), west of Halas in **Guardian Forest (NE/N)**. Kill it, loot the bracelet, and return to Deputy Sools.

Deputy Sools sends you to [**Captain Rulina**](place:1115), who forwards you to [**Mirea**](place:1116).

### 🔵 Blue Elemental Ring  
[**Mirea**](place:1116) is in **Salisearaneen (C)** near a small well. From CLW, follow the southern road past the Inn. Look for a small road sign and path leading east to a faerie village—Mirea is there. She sends you to kill an [**Ebony Wolf**](place:1117) (CONs yellow) in **Guardian Forest (S)**. Loot the ring and return to Deputy Sools.

Deputy Sools sends you to [**Juno Inhop**](place:1118) regarding a green earring.

### 🟢 Green Elemental Earring  
[**Juno Inhop**](place:1118) is in the Inn southeast of CLW. He sends you to kill a [**Frosteye Scarecrow**](place:1119) (CONs yellow) in **Diren Hold (SW)**. From Diren Village, head southwest toward the large mountain near Mt. Hatespike. The scarecrow is in a valley between two mountains. Loot the earring and return to Deputy Sools.

Deputy Sools sends you to [**Merchant Balboa**](place:1120) for a lockbox.

### 💰 Lockbox  
[**Merchant Balboa**](place:1120) is in Halas near the windmill. Pay **1,585 tunar**, then return to Deputy Sools.

Deputy Sools sends you back to [**Dixxon Tristar**](place:1109) with a letter.

---

### ✅ Quest Completion
Dixxon sends you to your **Class Guildmaster** in Castle Lightwolf (west side of the castle, 2nd floor):
- **Enchanter:** Trillon Zeber  
- **Rogue:** Tralum Lelam  
- **Shaman:** Sean Warlot  
- **Warrior:** Hilarn Strongfist

🎁 **Rewards:**
- **7,890,859 XP**  
- **Class/Path Item:**  
  - Enchanter: *Lycaon Beheader* **OR** *Tainted Black Wand*  
  - Rogue: *Black Tainted Knife* **OR** *Wolf Fang Knife*  
  - Shaman: *Skin Turned Kris* **OR** *Rabid Berserker*  
  - Warrior: *Lycaon Slasher* **OR** *Spirit Dancer*

---
---

quests.name: Group 3, Level 30
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Daresh  
**Location:** Murnf

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Lvl 30  
- Completion of your **Level 20 path quest**

---

Head to **Murnf** and speak with [**Daresh**](place:1142), who is upstairs in the building west of the coach *(for ease of quest completion, bind in Murnf)*. You are to find out everything you can from someone who works for an evil man named [**Bardif**](place:1143) *(without Bardif himself becoming aware of your enquiries)* and about his kidnapped son [**Tarlin**](place:1144).

Go to **Qeynos** to speak with Bardif's butler, [**Mergmar**](place:1145). To find him: from the main gate, head west, then west again, south through the long hall, then the first east door. He sends you to a contact in **Highpass**.

Seek a dark elf named [**Pwin**](place:1146). Pwin can be found in the north section of HP, standing in the corral *(the non-coach exit)*. Speak with him and report back to Daresh.

---

### 🔐 The Jailor
Daresh tells you that Pwin is associated with a small orc stronghold in **Hate Spike**. The Jailor there likely held the kidnapped boy overnight.

- Head to **Mt. Hate Spike (The Last Inn)** *(W)*. From the DM coach, go to the river and run north. Upon entering Hate Spike, go west up the first snowy valley to find the **Bloodfoot Stronghold**.
- The **Jailor** *(CONs db@30)* is down the ramp, right side at the end of the hallway, on the right side of the cavern.
- He is **always up**, not a triggered spawn.
- Kill him, loot the **Unintelligible Note**, and return to Daresh.

⚠️ *Bloodfoot Bandits see through invis.*

---

### 💰 Ricser
Daresh sends you to an Inn where Bardif’s messenger is waiting. His name is [**Ricser**](place:1147).

- Location: **Lost Watch Fort**  
- Coach to **Wyndhaven**, then run north ~5 minutes along the road *(Wynd NW)*
- Pay Ricser **1,600 tunar** and return to Daresh

---

### 💍 Ziliq
The note reveals Tarlin was taken to the **Green Rift** and met with [**Ziliq**](place:1148).

- Ziliq *(CONs db@30)* is located in **The Green Rift (W)**  
- Coach to **Bobble-by-Water**, head west *(long run, have SoW)*
- He is in a temple built into the side of the rift
- Kill him, loot **Ring of Gal'Saris**, and seek [**Kipcah**](place:1149)

---

### 🧭 Kipcah
- Coach to **FP**, exit north gate *(blacksmith)* and head west to **Marr’s Fist / Temple of Light (S)**
- Kipcah is in the center upon entering

He asks you to recover his **spyglass** from a Deathfist Lookout.

- Deathfist Lookout *(CONs yellow@30)* is southwest in **Deathfist Forge (NE)**, inside a hut
- Kill, loot the spyglass, and return to Kipcah

The spyglass is broken. Kipcah sends you to [**Gligbin**](place:1150) in **Klick'Anon**:
- Gligbin is next to a wagon just inside the white gate
- No tunar required

Return the repaired spyglass to Kipcah. He reveals Tarlin’s location.

---

### 🔓 Free Tarlin
- Head to **Deathfist Forge (S)**, southwest from Kipcah
- Kill [**Urtwar**](place:1151) *(CONs red@30)* at the top of the ramp on the right
- Invis in; a cleric sees invis partway up
- Loot the **Orc Shackle Key**, speak with [**Tarlin**](place:1144) to free him

---

### ✅ Quest Completion
Return to [**Daresh**](place:1142). You will be rewarded with:

- **7,890,859 XP**  
- **Path Ability**  
- **Item Choice:**
  - **Druid:** Mishtur's Book **OR** Stormchaser  
  - **Magician:** Sifarus Wand **OR** Staff of Dooog  
  - **Monk:** Swiftclaw **OR** Resounding Staff  
  - **Ranger:** Springwind **OR** Sapoak Club

---
---

**NPC:** Daresh  
**Location:** Murnf

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Lvl 40  
- Completion of your **Level 30 path quest**

---

Speak with [**Daresh**](place:1142). Tarlin returned angry and has taken up necromancer arts. Bardif blames the druids and wants amends.

### 💰 Bardif
- Go to **Qeynos** and pay Bardif **3,000 tunar**
- Location: main entrance → main hall → left → end → side room left → first house right, second floor

⚠️ *Wereforms beware of Julie Tanner, the werehunter.*

---

### 🧾 Mergmar
- Speak with [**Mergmar**](place:1145), downstairs from Bardif
- He hints Tarlin liked floating towers in the north
- Return to Daresh

---

### 🏚️ Bandits
- Head to **Wyndhaven**, run east toward the fort on the hill near the ravine
- Kill [**Tarlin’s Bandits**](place:1153) *(CONs LB–DB@40)* in the two towers
- Loot the note and return

---

### 🗡️ Assassin
- Go to **Qeynos** and enter Bardif’s house
- Assassin *(CONs db@40)* attacks immediately
- Kill, loot dagger, return to Daresh

---

### 📨 Three Messengers
Kill [**Tarlin’s Agents**](place:1154) *(CONs yellow@40, triggered)*:
1. **Ferran’s Hope (C)** – Blacktongue Orc village
2. **Deathfist Citadel** – near throne or ramp
3. **Great Waste (NE)** – inside main building

Loot all notes and return.

---

### 💀 Necromantic Gems  
**A) Vahk'Kiv** *(Guk S, CONs Yel@40)* – loot **Gem of Night**  
**B) Daglader** *(Tomb of Kings, CONs red@40)* – loot **Rune of Corpses**

Return both gems to Daresh.

---

### 🧟 Tarlin’s Guards

quests.name: Group 4, Level 30
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Belran Nightrift  
**Location:** Dark Solace

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 30
- Completion of your **Level 20 path quest**  
- ⚠️ *If you are an eastern human cleric or rogue and have low faction with Dark Solace, see NOTE at the end.*

---

### 📖 Quest Walkthrough

Talk to [**Belran Nightrift**](place:1168) in Dark Solace. He will tell you a short tale about the ritual season and the need for a tome. You offer to help.

You are sent to **Muniels Tea Garden** to kill [**Jolin Tofeph**](place:1169) *(CONs Yel@30)*. He can be found at the top of a tower near the coachman. Kill him and loot the **Bloody Letter**.

Inspect the **Bloody Letter**. It hints that [**Nalzik P'Thek**](place:1170) in Freeport once had the tome but sold it. Coach to **Freeport**, head north, and go to the **2nd floor of the guild building by the dockmaster** to speak with Nalzik.

Nalzik P'Thek tells you he will only give you the buyer’s name if you do him a favor. He sends you to [**Holciel Rowen'Dal**](place:1171) to collect the **Windstream Cutlass** from the **Lesser Halls**.

Travel to the **Tomb of Kings** (long run west from Freeport). Locate and kill [**Tariel Windstream**](place:1172) *(CONs Red@30)* — he is a ghost and casts spells. Loot the **Windstream Cutlass** and return to Nalzik P'Thek.

> 📝 **Note:** When you reach the room where **Niktuu** is for the level 33 quests, take the exit in the left corner and explore that side of the Tomb of Kings for **Tinael**.  
> ⚠️ Tinael is found on the **left side** of the Tomb, not the right (which is full of red-cons and death). On your way in, pick up a **tea set** from Niktuu — you’ll need it for level 33 quests.

Nalzik now tells you that [**Falder Malinar**](place:1173) *(CONs Yel@30)* has the tome. He is located upstairs in the **Shining Serpent Inn** (Bard Guild) in Freeport. Kill Falder and loot the **Ransom Note**:

> *"Falder, we have your tome. Meet us at the well near the docks. Bring 1,600 tunar."*

Take **1,600 tunar** and head to the well by the Freeport coach. Near a large rock, you will find [**Grimefod Philch**](place:1174). Speak with him and give him the money. When he attacks you, kill him and loot the **Antiquated Ring**. Return to Nalzik P'Thek.

Upon inspecting the ring, Nalzik explains it is the **Ring of Infinite Uselessness**, once owned by [**Eljin Rindain**](place:1175). You can find Eljin upstairs at the **Rusted Lantern Inn** near the Freeport coach area.

When you speak to Eljin Rindain, he summons a **Compelled Shade** *(CONs Wht@30)* and attacks you himself *(CONs Red)*. Kill Eljin and loot the **Tome of Dimensional Gates**.

---

### ✅ Quest Completion
Return to [**Belran Nightrift**](place:1168) in Dark Solace.

**Rewards:**
- 🧠 **7,890,859 XP**
- **Cleric:** Elemental Guard *(+35 to each resist)* and **Dark Priest Warhammer** **OR** Bind Wounds and **Dark Priest Hammer**
- **Enchanter:** Expansive Mind and **Deceptive Staff** **OR** Power Jet and **Tainted Crystal Staff**
- **Rogue:** Evasion and **Steelthorn** **OR** Lesser Wound and **Ironspike**

---
---

quests.name: Group 4, Level 40
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Thalnix D'Rinas  
**Location:** South Crossroads (Dark Solace)

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 40
- Completion of your **Level 30 path quest**

---

Talk to [**Thalnix D'Rinas**](place:1176) (found opposite Belran Nightrift) in Dark Solace. He tells you the history of the **Great Crystal** and sends you to collect **four crystal shards** by completing four tests and defeating four golems. These can be done in any order.

### 🪨 Golem of Fear — *Deathfist Forge*
Speak with [**Orish Thulon**](place:1177) in Deathfist Forge (E). He sends you on the **Test of Fear**. Travel to **Deathfist Citadel (C)** and kill a [**Deathfist Fire Weaver**](place:1178) *(CONs LB)* near the trader in the center of camp. Loot the **Medicine Bag**, return to Orish, then kill the golem *(CONs Yel@40)* and loot the **Crystalline Shard of Fear**.

### 🪨 Golem of Station — *Stone Watchers*
Find [**Watcher Mironar**](place:1180) in Stone Watchers (SE), on the green-glowing hill with stone pillars. He sends you to collect **three large ant carapaces** from the **Ant Colonies** (south). Kill black ant guards and carpenters until you have them. Return to Mironar, kill the awakened golem, and loot the **Crystalline Shard of Station**.

### 🪨 Golem of Strength — *Great Waste*
In Great Waste (SE), find [**Drelk Trunkfist**](place:1183) in a half-shell. Kill Drelk *(CONs Yel@40)* to complete the test. Give his sword to the golem, then kill the golem and loot the **Crystalline Shard of Greed**.

### 🪨 Golem of Greed — *Dark Solace*
Near the invisible wall in Dark Solace, pay [**Windle Gearprofit**](place:1184) **2,500 tunar**. Kill the golem *(CONs Yel@40)* and loot the **Crystalline Shard of Greed**.

---

### ✅ Quest Completion
Return all **four shards** to [**Thalnix D'Rinas**](place:1176), then speak with [**Belran Nightrift**](place:1168).

**Rewards:**
- 🧠 **14,919,719 XP**
- **Cleric:** Elemental Barrier *(+45 to each resist)* and **Night Priest Warhammer** **OR** Quick Stitching and **Cursed Morning Star**
- **Enchanter:** Limitless Mind and **Enthralling Branch** **OR** Power Surge and **Dark Visage Rattle**
- **Rogue:** Evade and **Twisted Dagger** **OR** Wound and **Steelsliver**

---
---

quests.name: Group 4, Level 49
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Thalnix D'Rinas  
**Location:** South Crossroads (Dark Solace)

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 49
- Completion of your **Level 40 path quest**

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** Ensure you have plenty of inventory space. Save **everything** NPCs give you until the quest is fully completed and your path ability is chosen.

---

Talk to [**Gribble Greencog**](place:1186) in Dark Solace to log your quest. He needs **four ciphers** to complete *The Calling*. To create them, you must gather **two translations** of the **Tomes of Sun, Moon, and Stars**.

### 📘 Tome 1 — *Kelinar*
Travel from **Gunter's Mine** north along the mountains to **Kelinar**. Kill the following casters (all in watchtowers, second floor):
- [**Faelial Elminiea**](place:1187) *(South)*
- [**Lomal Hindel**](place:1188) *(Southeast)*
- [**Llinior Orinial**](place:1189) *(Center)*
- [**Kalen Falder**](place:1190) *(Center, further east)*

Loot all four tomes.

### 📘 Tome 2 — *Salt Mines of Caer Sloth*
From **Forkwatch** (or NE from Dark Solace), travel east to the Salt Mines. Near the bottom, before the spider area, kill [**Collin Ilbeth**](place:1191) and loot the **Old Common Moon Tome**.

### 📘 Tome 3 — *Salt Mines (Deeper)*
Proceed deeper past Collin Ilbeth, down the ramps, through the drachnid gorgers, and into the circular room. Take the **fourth door on the right**, go down the ramp, kill the [**Body Snatcher**](place:1192), and loot the **Ancient Elven Moon Tome**.

Return to [**Gribble**](place:1186), then travel to **Highpass** and speak with [**Feldink Shortquill**](place:1075) in the keep. Bring him **3,300 tunar** to create the ciphers.

Return to Gribble. He begins the ritual of **The Calling**. Stand at the **Invisible Man** location to summon the [**Avatar of Lord Chardith**](place:1193). Kill it, loot **Ethereal Matter**, and then speak with [**Belran Nightrift**](place:1168).

You are sent to [**Archmagus Terathin**](place:1161).

---

### 🔮 Summoning Lord Chardith
> 💡 **Tip:** If possible, group with others on this quest and gather all drops first. Doing so can reduce this stage to **2 minutes** instead of over an hour.

Travel to **Oasis**, then southwest to **Takish Hiz**. On the outskirts, find the building with the **blue lightning bolt sign**. Enter the basement and find [**Archmagus Terathin**](place:1161).

Agree to help him destroy the Magi. Choose which Magus to fight (order does not matter).

⚠️ **Important:** Only kill Magi **after** speaking with Terathin. Otherwise, they drop **fake phylacteries**.

#### ☀️ Sun Magus
Fight through the sun knight corridor, kill the **Sun Magus**, loot the **Sun Phylactery**, and return to Terathin.

#### ⭐ Star Magus
Fight through the star wisp area, kill the **Star Magus**, loot the **Star Phylactery**, and return.

#### 🌙 Moon Magus
Carefully clear moon wraiths (some see invis), kill the **Moon Magus**, and loot the **Moon Phylactery**.

After turning in all three, Terathin allows you to choose your **Epic Weapon** from the jeweled chest. This choice is **final**.

Speak to Terathin again to summon [**Lord Chardith**](place:1165). A scripted sacrifice occurs, then Chardith spawns. Kill him and loot **Bone of Chardith**.

---

### 🏁 Final Quest Completion
Return to [**Gribble Greencog**](place:1186). He sends you to a class-specific NPC to finalize your **Level 49 Path Ability**.

You will revisit NPCs representing your **Level 20, 30, and 40 quests**, collecting notes of approval. Return them to your NPC to choose your final ability.

**Final Rewards:**
- 🧠 **45,558,313 XP**
- **Cleric:** **Hammer of Absolution** **OR** **Mace of Repentance** *(Ward of Blessings: +65 resist, +10% WIS mod)*
- **Enchanter:** **Glory of Elddar** **OR** **Mithril Eagle Rod**
- **Rogue:** **Blacktongue [2]** **OR** **Heartsbane [2]**

---

### 🧾 Final NOTE (Eastern Human Cleric/Rogue)
Speak with [**Davek Malall**](place:1194) in Freeport (first floor of the cleric temple). He grants **+1000 faction with Dark Solace**, allowing you to pass through the wall and log the **Level 30 quest**.

quests.name: Group 5, Level 30
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Director Holman  
**Location:** Zentar's Keep

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 30  
- Completion of your **Level 20 Path Quest**

---

Talk to [**Director Holman**](place:1196) at Zentar's Keep. Holman can be found at the foot of the very tall statue near the coach. He needs you to obtain **three items**:
- **Thulian Circlet**  
- **Wraps of Bertoxxulous**  
- **Hatesplint Tunic**

There are three NPCs at Zentar's Keep who provide clues for each item (speaking to them is not required to advance the quest):
- [**Mystic Horga**](place:1197) — west of the coach  
- **Sorceress D'Nedra** — west of the coach, 3rd floor  
- [**Warlord Honan**](place:1198) — northeast, on top of the wall

***📝 Note:** You can talk to all three NPCs at once while in Zentar's Keep.*

---

### 👑 Thulian Circlet
Talk to [**Mystic Horga**](place:1197). He sends you to Freeport to speak with the gnome merchant [**Twindle Fizzmop**](place:945). Twindle admits he has the circlet but will only sell it for **1,600 tunar** and a **Scared Monarch**.

Go to **Mayfly Glade (W)** and kill a **Monarch Butterfly** *(CON blue to 30)*. It is an easy kill, but monarchs will swarm you. Return to Twindle Fizzmop to receive the **Thulian Circlet** and **350,000 XP**.

---

### ☠️ Wraps of Bertoxxulous
Talk to [**Warlord Honan**](place:1198). He sends you to the **Salt Mines** to speak with [**Slave Master Hern**](place:1199) (if he will talk to you). Hern is found in **Salt Mines (W)**, in a castle on a hill, standing near the north wall.

Slave Master Hern is short on manpower and wants **three bar patrons**. Travel to **Qeynos**. North of the coach is an inn. Go inside and wait for [**Lora Greyson**](place:1200) *(CON blue to 30)* to spawn. Kill her. Wait for her to respawn and kill her again. Do this a third time until you have **three bar patrons** in your inventory.

Return to Slave Master Hern to receive the **Wraps of Bertoxxulous**, **+50 faction with Caer Sloth**, and **350,000 XP**.

---

### 🧥 Hatesplint Tunic
Talk to **Sorceress D'Nedra**. She sends you to **Fort Seriak** to speak with **J'Lisa U'Dedane**, located west of the coach. U'Dedane wants a gem from **Quicktoe**, a halfling.

Quicktoe can be found at the bottom of a pit in **Runnyeye Citadel**. Use invisibility to enter. Go through the main gate, pass a door and two sentries, turn left, then left again. At the first bridge crossing, **jump all the way down**.

When you hit the bottom, you may be attacked by several mobs. Kill them. Face the ramps and go **up the right ramp**, one level, into the west tunnel. You will receive a popup indicating a fight between **Quicktoe** *(CON yellow to 30)* and **three goblins** *(CON blue to 30)*. You may let him kill the goblins first or kill everything yourself. Be aware: **Quicktoe hits hard and heals**.

Kill Quicktoe and loot the gem.

> 📝 **Note:** Sometimes Quicktoe does not have the gem. You may need to wait for a respawn.

Return to **J'Lisa U'Dedane** with the U'Dedane gem to receive the **Hatesplint Jerkin**, **+50 faction with House U'Dedane**, and **350,000 XP**.

---

### ✅ QUEST COMPLETION (Level 30)
You should now have all three items: **Circlet**, **Wraps**, and **Tunic**. Return to [**Director Holman**](place:1196) for your final reward.

He will send you to one of the following for your **PATH reward**:
- [**Warlord Honan**](place:1198) — Warriors  
- [**Mystic Horga**](place:1197) — Shaman  
- [**Sorceress G'Nera**](place:1201) — Wizard  
- [**Sorceress Nime**](place:1202) — Alchemist

**Reward:** 🧠 **7,890,859 XP**

---
---

quests.name: Group 5, Level 40
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Director Holman  
**Location:** Zentar's Keep

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 40  
- Completion of your **Level 30 Path Quest**

---

Talk to [**Director Holman**](place:1196), who sends you to [**Zentar Reese**](place:1204) at the top of the keep. To find him, go up the south ramp past the spiritbinder and continue upward.

Zentar describes a vision of the **Unkempt Wood** twisted and ruined. He requires the **blood of his line** and sends you to kill his son, [**Carrick Reese**](place:1205).

---

### 🩸 Carrick Reese & His Blood
Carrick Reese can be found in **Mariel Village (C)** among the elves. He is in one of the trees with two elves and does not initially aggro *(CONs LB)*. When his health gets low, he will **SoW and flee**, so kill him quickly. Loot his body and return to Zentar.

Bring Carrick’s body to [**Mystic Horga**](place:1197) (same building, lower floor). Horga drains the blood and gives you a bottle. Because Carrick was not evil, the blood must be corrupted.

Take the blood to [**Hierophant Koligo**](place:213) in **Grobb**. From the river, make a right, pass under the tree, repeat twice, then take the next right through a tree entrance (just before the bank).

Koligo requires two items:

#### 🪄 The Sceptre of Tal'Thaz
An ancient elven artifact. Buy it for **3,000 tunar** from [**Twindle Fizzmop**](place:945) in Freeport near the bank. He offers **two** scepters — the cheap one is fake.

#### 🔥 The Bonecaster's Censer
Found in **Guk Dungeon**. Invis in, follow left paths off the circle room. In the final dead-end room near Bonecasters and Heart Spiders, a popup appears — choose to take the censer.

Return to Koligo to corrupt the blood, then return to Zentar. *Map of Guk Dungeon*

---

### 🌿 Zentar's Plan
Zentar explains his plan to defile [**Nature's Altar**](place:1210). You must collect **three essences** by killing [**Forces of Nature**](place:1207) *(CONs white to yellow)*: **Sun, Soil, Rain**.

Travel to **Wyndhaven**, head north along the shoreline, then east in **Mariel Village**. Stay north of the east–west mountain chain. You will find the Forces of Nature at **Twisted Tower (C)**. Kill them and loot all three essences.

Take the essences and the blood to **Unkempt Glade (C)**. From the druid camp, follow the road north briefly, go over the northwest hill, and find a lake with an island and a tree. Approach the tree to receive a popup — the tree takes the essences and gives you the **Golden Fruit**.

Travel to [**Nature's Altar**](place:1210). From the island, return southeast to the road, follow it north to a druid village. The altar is east of the road on a large hill with a **Stonehenge circle**. Approach the center, pour Carrick’s blood, and spawn [**Oakhollow**](place:1209) *(CONs red)*. Kill it, loot the heart, then return to the altar and choose **break the heart**.

---

### ✅ QUEST COMPLETION (Level 40)
Return to [**Zentar Reese**](place:1204).

**Rewards:**
- 🧠 **14,919,719 XP**
- **Alchemist:** Professor's Knack **OR** Neriak Cocktail  
- **Shaman:** Spirit Focus & Darkflame Club **OR** Wilting Wind & Darkflame Spear  
- **Warrior:** Howl & Calamitous Falchion **OR** Pillar of Force & Calamitous Poleaxe  
- **Wizard:** Freezing Clash & Blightbringer's Staff **OR** Mental Boost & Blightbringer's Wand

---
---

quests.name: Group 5, Level 49
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Zentar Reese  
**Location:** Zentar's Keep

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 49  
- Completion of your **Level 40 Path Quest**

> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT:** Ensure you have plenty of inventory space. Save **all items** NPCs give you until your final rewards and final Path ability are complete.

---

Zentar speaks of dreams involving a great ice creature and asks you to bring him the **Star of Salisearaneen**.

### 🧚 Faerie Protector
Travel to **Salisearaneen (N)**. The [**Faerie Protector**](place:1211) *(CONs LB)* spawns near a druidic stone in a small faerie village between two hills. Approach the stone to trigger faerie attacks. After defeating waves, the Faerie Protector spawns. Kill him and loot the **Faerie Crystal**.

Place the crystal on the stone via popup and withdraw the **Star of Salisearaneen**.

Return to Zentar. He sends you to [**Twindle Fizzmop**](place:945) near the Freeport blacksmith to buy the **Gear of Hazoran**. He asks **8,000 tunar**, but haggling lowers it to **5,000 tunar**. Return to Zentar.

---

### ❄️ Seal 3 — Permafrost
Zentar explains that **Seals 1 & 2** are already gathered by [**Oransan**](place:1098). You must gather the final two seals.

Travel to **Permafrost (N)** and kill [**Frostborn III**](place:1100) *(CONs LB@49)*. He roams the halls near Vox Castle. Loot his sword.

Take the sword to the **Ice Throne Room** and drive it into the throne to spawn [**Frostborn II**](place:1101) *(CONs Yellow@49)*. Kill him and loot **Frostcleaver** *(3/4 seals)*.

> ⚠️ Wizards and shamans see through invis. Do not loot Voxite Mages or they will respawn.

---

### 🏰 Seal 4 — Unnamed King
Go to **Anu Village (NE)**. Enter the fort through the broken bridge. Invis before entering to avoid undead archers. Navigate down the ramp and prepare.

Kill [**Tolo Grimsteel**](place:1102) and [**Ganron Lorebane**](place:1103) *(CONs Red@49)* and loot their gems. Move the group to the back-right corner. The quester approaches the column to summon the [**Unnamed King**](place:1104) *(CONs Yellow@49)*. Kill him and loot the **Unnamed Crown** *(4/4 seals)*.

---

### 🧊 PARATHIOR
Bring all four seals to [**Oransan**](place:1098) at the broken tower in **Snowblind Plains (N)**, just west of the bear cave. After a ritual, [**Parathior**](place:1105) spawns from the sky.

Speak to [**Orinas (bear form)**](place:1106) immediately to choose your **Epic Weapon**, then prepare for battle. Stay downhill behind the tree to avoid AoE. Kill Parathior and loot an **Ice Chunk**.

---

### 🏁 QUEST COMPLETION (Level 49)
Return to [**Zentar Reese**](place:1204). He sends you to a class-specific NPC to finalize your **Level 49 Path Ability**.

You must visit three NPCs representing your **Level 20, 30, and 40 quests** to collect approval notes, then return for your final ability.

Class-specific notes:
- **Warriors:** Anu Village (SW), speak to the four warlords among the stones  
- **Shamans:** Guardian Forest (E), speak to **Elder Gabgug** in the druid rock circle  
- **Alchemists:** **Brindy Roro** in Highpass, then three NPCs in the next room

**Final Rewards:**
- 🧠 **45,558,313 XP**  
- Your **Level 49 Path Ability**  
- **Alchemist:** Epic (class-specific)  
- **Shaman:** Epic Spear **OR** Epic Club  
- **Warrior:** Epic Great Axe **OR** Epic Longsword  
- **Wizard:** Epic Rod **OR** Epic Staff

---

### 📝 Level 30 Path Quest Faction Note
If [**Slave Master Hern**](place:1199) will not speak to you, your **Caer Sloth** faction is too low (often from XPing at Siloths). You must raise it to **-99**. Kill **Darkwood Goblins** southwest of **Darvor Manor** in **Alseop's Wall**. Each goblin grants **+1 Caer Sloth faction** — this may take time.

quests.name: Group 6, Level 30
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Count Luvincius  
**Location:** Oasis

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 30  
- Completion of your **Level 20 Path Quest**

---

Talk to [**Count Luvincius**](place:1213) to log your quest. He is at the top of **Resenthorn Tower** in Oasis, on the island in the middle of the river. He asks you to prove yourself by finding [**Quatzi**](place:1214) and purchasing some goods from him.

Quatzi is just outside near the dark tower by the beach. Exit the tower; he is on your left near the shore. Purchase **3 vials of gypsy blood** for **1,584 tunar** and return to Luvincius.

Luvincius sends you to [**Talknar**](place:1215) in **Dark Solace**, outside the drow enclave near a rock. He explains that goblins have been attacking everyone despite a pact to leave each other alone.

He sends you to kill a [**Goblin Messenger**](place:1216) *(CONs wht@30)*. Head due **NE** from Talknar, over a hill, to the crossroads. This goblin is a **triggered spawn** near a tree where all roads meet. Kill him, loot the **goblin message**, and return to Talknar.

---

### 🏳️ The Ambassadors
Talknar sends you to [**Gungar Guglar**](place:1217), located at an outpost outside **Grobb**, just west of the coach. Gungar sends you to [**Tracker Jugl**](place:1218), standing nearby next to a stump with his dog **Bloodseeker**.

Tracker Jugl sends you to kill [**Ambassador Kreek**](place:1219) and [**Ambassador Luj'Nak**](place:1220), found outside **Guk**. Facing the stone entrance, climb on top of the **left wall**. The ambassadors are **triggered spawns** at the top. Although they con light blue, they are **casters** and may require help.

Kill them, loot the [**goblin**](place:1216) and **froglok treaties**, and return to Gungar. Gungar then tells you to return to Luvincius.

---

### 🐺 Gutripper
Count Luvincius is unhappy that the goblins broke the pact and sends you to kill [**Gut Ripper**](place:1221) as a warning to **Chik'Nar**, the goblin king.

[**Gut Ripper**](place:1221) *(CONs DB@30)* is found in **Alseop's Wall**, inside the goblin **Darkwood Lair** cave. Invis inside, stay to the right, take the **second tunnel on the right** into Cookie’s room, hang a left, then go straight back. Guards con **LB**.

**Strategy:** Invis yourself and your pet, stand next to Gut Ripper on the ramp, send your pet in while you remain invis. You may get one add, but the lower guards will not aggro. Shadowknights may need to clear the room first.

Kill Gut Ripper, loot him, and return to Luvincius.

---

### ✅ QUEST COMPLETION (Level 30)  
**Reward:** 🧠 **7,890,859 XP**
- **Magician:** Wolfbane Staff **OR** Wolf Bone Totem  
- **Necromancer:** Bone Totem of the Wolf **OR** Sickle of the Wolf  
- **Shadowknight:** Claymore of the Shadow Wolf **OR** Partisan of Wolf Slaying

---
---

quests.name: Group 6, Level 40
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Count Luvicious  
**Location:** Oasis

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 40  
- Completion of your **Level 30 Path Quest**

---

Talk to **Count Luvicious** in Resenthorn Tower. He sends you to [**Quatzi**](place:1214) outside the tower to buy a **vial of Elven blood** for **2,766 tunar**. Return to Luvicious.

---

### ⚔️ Goblin Attackers – Honjour
Luvicious sends you to [**Captain Opak**](place:1222) in **Honjour**, located in the southeast part of the fort. Opak asks you to speak with [**Watcher Gabnu**](place:1223) at the top of a tower directly south of town.

After speaking with Watcher Gabnu, **three waves** of mobs spawn:
- Goblin Elites *(CON grn@40)*  
- Froglok Elites *(CONs wht@40)*  
- The Captain

Kill all mobs until you loot **one Glowing Silver Shard (ntl)**. Speak again with Watcher Gabnu, then return north to [**Captain Opak**](place:1222).

Opak gives you a note and tells you to return to **Count Luvicious** in Oasis. You are commended, but sent onward to **Kerplunk Outpost**.

---

### 🐊 Goblin Attackers – Kerplunk
Speak with [**Elder Pugnug**](place:1225) in **Kerplunk Outpost** (center of village near the coach). He wants revenge on **Da Snapper** *(CONs WHT)*, who spawns in the nearby lake.

Kill Da Snapper and loot:
- Half-eaten note  
- Chunk of mysterious ore  
- Corpse of Grub

Return to Pugnug. He heals Grub, who is not fully dead. Return to Luvicious with the remaining items.

---

### 🐸 Froglok Tactician
Luvicious sends you to kill [**Chareek the Tactician**](place:1226) *(CONs Red@40)* in **Guk Dungeon**, living side near the lower levels. Invis is required.

Clear the room first — multiple brutes, knights, and patrols will assist him. Chareek is initially **unattackable**; speak with him to spawn the killable version. Kill him and loot **all drops** (including head and hide). Return to Luvicious.

---

### ✅ QUEST COMPLETION (Level 40)  
**Reward:** 🧠 **14,919,719 XP**
- **Magician:** Fiery Pebble **OR** Earthen Mark  
- **Necromancer:** Blood Storm **OR** Power Storm  
- **Shadowknight:** Bloodleech **OR** Grim Tower

---
---

quests.name: Group 6, Level 49
quests.guide:
**NPC:** Count Luvincius  
**Location:** Oasis

---

### 📌 Requirements
- Level 49  
- Completion of your **Level 40 Path Ability**

> ⚠️ **Important:** Make room in your inventory. You must carry **all quest items** to trigger spawns and dialogue. Delete items only after receiving your final rewards.

---

Talk to [**Count Luvincius**](place:1213) at Resenthorn Tower. He tells you about [**Lord Chardith**](place:1165) and gives you the **Tome of Anikhius**, instructing you to gather **three ciphers** by speaking with [**Elimandared**](place:1227).

---

### ☀️ Cipher of the Sun — Elimandared
Elimandared is found in **Ethernal Desert (W)**. Head north from Oasis to the level 43 quest tower, then west to a small hill with dim ruins.

Elimandared tests you by summoning **Tubrenzalana** *(caster, CONs red@49)*. She uses AoE spells repeatedly. Kill her and loot her staff.

Elimandared gives you the **Stone of Elves** and sends you to **Fayspires** to buy a **Rune of Water** from [**Aalean Mardum**](place:1228) (guild on the left, second floor). Buy it for **3,200 tunar** and return.

You receive the **Cipher of the Sun (1/3)** and are sent to **Sarek’s Tower**.

---

### 🌙 Cipher of the Moon — Vaeloficint the Wise
Vaeloficint resides at **Sarek’s Tower (C)**, top of the west tower. He gives you the **Script of the Moon** and sends you to **Cazic Thule (N)**.

Find [**Inspector Xelebb**](place:1230), a floating eye at the base of the pyramid. Speak with him to make him attackable. Kill him, loot the **rubicitic charm**, and return.

You receive the **Cipher of the Moon (2/3)** and are sent to **Highpass Hold**.

---

### ⭐ Cipher of the Star — Historian Hesslen
Speak with [**Historian Hesslen**](place:1231) in Highpass Hold, under the ramp near the original bank. He sends you to **Box Canyons (SE)** to kill [**Overlord Frank**](place:1232).

Overlord Frank is a **triggered spawn** in a Takish bandit camp. You must approach very closely. Kill him, loot his ring, and return.

Hesslen sends you to kill [**Xannasu**](place:1233), a treant in **Sycamore Joy’s Rest (C)** within the Enchanted Forest. Pull him outside the green bubble to reduce adds. Kill him and loot the branch.

*NOTE:* Xannasu is triggered by passing through the twin-pillar gate **without invis**.

Next, return to Box Canyons and kill [**Lantik**](place:1234) *(CONs Yel@49)* from the northern entrance. Lantik is also a **triggered spawn**. Loot his bracers and return.

Hesslen gives you the **Cipher of the Star (3/3)** and sends you back to Count Luvincius, who directs you to [**Archmagus Terathin**](place:1161) in **Takish Hiz (SW)**.

---

### 🔥 To Summon Chardith
Travel to **Takish Hiz (SW)** from Oasis. On the east side of the ruins, find a building with a **blue lightning bolt sign** and enter the basement.

Speak with [**Archmagus Terathin**](place:1161) and agree to help destroy the Magi. Choose each Magus in any order.

#### SUN
Kill the **Sun Magus** and loot the **Sun Phylactery**.

#### STAR
Kill the **Star Magus** and loot the **Star Phylactery**.

#### MOON
Kill the **Moon Magus** and loot the **Moon Phylactery**.

Terathin only speaks every **15 minutes** — be patient.

After turning in all three, open the jeweled chest and choose your **Epic Weapon**. This choice is permanent.

Speak to Terathin again to summon [**Lord Chardith**](place:1165). After a scripted sacrifice, Chardith spawns. Kill him and loot **one Bone of Chardith**.

---

### 🏁 QUEST COMPLETION (Level 49)
Return to [**Count Luvincius**](place:1213). He sends you to a class-specific NPC to finalize your **Level 49 Path Ability**.

You must visit representatives of your **Level 20, 30, and 40 quests** to receive approval notes, then return.

- **Necromancers:** Bottom floor of the Count’s tower  
- **Shadowknights:** Top of a tower in Zentar’s Keep

**Final Rewards:**
- 🧠 **45,558,313 XP**  
- Your **Level 49 Path Ability**  
- **Magician:** Crystalmana Crosier **OR** Rod of Elemental Union  
- **Necromancer:** Rod of Consuming Hatred **OR** Sickle of Avhi Escron  
- **Shadowknight:** Beheader of Isthiak **OR** Downfall

quests.guide:
**Quest NPC:** Blank con in tomb  
**Location:** Dead Hills (E)


**The only reason to do this quest is to get the Dead Hills group port, but only Wizards, Druids, and Necromancers are rewarded with a port at the end of the quest. If you are a Wiz/Drd, you are better off doing the Fendren the Forgotten quest for your port. Much easier, less work, and ports you and your grp to the same place. Usually only necs do this quest as the rewards for all other classes are just not the worth the work of this quest.

In the Deadhills E, there is a big hill with a tomb on top. Most walkthroughs say you will receive a popup in the front of the tomb, but CS didn't. We found, in the front of the door, on the left, you will be able to con a blank. Con it and talk to it, you recieve instructions to start the quest. (So, idk if they've altered the quest a bit or not, this is as of Jan/06) Beware, though, because the surrounding mummies and zombies have SoW and see invis. You will need to clear them to have time to read the instructions.

You are told to go to Deadhills W, to the Lizardman ruins, it's a two minute run. You will find 3 towers there. You'll get a pop-up in one of the towers.

You are then instructed to locate an NPC named Nolius Adder who can be found in Hagley Village, in a house.

Adder sends you to West Feerroot Mountains W. There you find a Ghastly Kin cave. Inside is a tomb where you will get a pop-up and will be ambushed an Ancient Spirit, a level 55 caster/healer. Note: The sprit is surrounded by 4 casters who con green (they look like enchanter animations). Do not go all the way to the bottom of the cave. The Spirit spawns in a side cave closer to the top. Once you have defeated it, loot it, and an NPC lizard man will spawn. If you are in a group, only one person can speak with him at a time.

(NOTE: You are given a choice when you first get the popup. Do NOT choose to wave your arms and jump up and down as Nolius Adder advised you to. If you do that, he will despawn and you'll have to kill the Ancient Spirit again. Chose to: Address the empty room and ask about the dead hills.).

However, the pop-up reoccurs about every 5-10 minutes. Each party in your group, with the quest, will have to wait his turn to speak.

The NPC instructs you to head to Envar. When approaching the north door of the castle of Envar you will recieve a pop-up which instructs you to investigate the NW tower of the castle

(NOTE: This popup is on the road leading into the north door, it is a good ways before you get to the door. (Be uninvised to get popup) It advises you: As a cloud of ashen dust parts before you, the origins of the Dead Hills' blight reveals itself to you).

To climb the towers, you must go downstairs through one of the two stairways in the center of the complex. It is very important that you pick the right one. If you're coming in from the north entrance, the stairway that leads to the NW and SW towers is the one farthest from you. The one closest to you goes to the NE and SE towers only. Here is a link for a map of envar to help you navigate.

Once in the NW tower, you will recieve another pop-up which will instruct you to investigate the dungeon.

Below the NW tower you will encounter Accursed Maggots and Accursed Zombies. Both are deadly, run at double speed, see invis, and have an extensive aggro range. The Maggots have a Root/AoE spell which nukes for 1,000. The Zombies cast a DoT which causes 1,500 damage a tick. Both of which however can be cured if you have acquired the spell Envaric Salve, which drops off of the Accursed Maggots. If you don't have the spell, now might be a good time to farm for it, seeing as you're there.

Once inside the dungeon, go down the left hallway and attempt to con either  Tal Thir or Servant of Tal Thir. You have to go inside the room in which they are located to receive the next popup. If at all possible, avoid a confrontation with Tal Thir as it cons red to a 55, has a 6k crit and drains mana.

> ⚠️ **Note:** Before you make the last turn and go into the anteroom to Tal Thir's chamber, there is a specific trouble spot. There is a short hallway and an adjacent room to the left.  A zombie roams in and out of that room. Also there are two maggots inside and two just around the corner to the left. Be careful not to pull or taunt in the doorway to the room as you could aggro all 5 mobs in the area. Also, try not to loot the zombie. He moves so fast that he is hard to taunt, and if he hits anyone other than the MT, they are probably going to die from the tick. Take your time and clear that area meticulously before moving on to the bosses.  If your group or raiding party gets wiped out, it's very hard to rez back. The roaming maggots and zombies will reappear and kill anything that moves. You have to rez and run back to the empty room (prior to making the last 2 turns). Again this is not easy because if you draw aggro and run in, you could inadvertently train those who had rezzed and made it to safety.

Once you've gotten the pop-up, you are instructed you to speak with Kradesh Du' Klot in Freeport. Du' Klot can be found in a bar house near the docks. He asks that you return with a book which was stolen by Rogue Ethrix. Ethrix can be found in the Pilgrim's Inn located along the road leading from the N gate in Freeport. The north road turns westy towards the Temple of Light...keep following the road towards Highpass a couple of minutes more and you will find yourself at the Pilgrim's Inn. Rogue Ethrix spawns inside the inn, under a set of stairs every 4-8 hours. (actually, we found the respawn rate was lower, maybe every 2 hours). He is easy to solo at 60.

After killing Rogue Ethrix you also need to bring 7k tunar with you to pay Kradesh and continue the quest.

Kradesh now sends you back to Envar and again into the NW tower. Return to the throne room and kill the Servant of Tal' Thir. The servant cons yellow to a level 55 and life taps for 550. After you have defeated him, he will reappear as an NPC. He instructs you to seek out other servants. Note: only one person with the quest can talk to the spawned NPC, so you have to do this over and over again. Because the spawn time on the Servant is long, this can take days.

Go to the bottom of the tower in Envar SE. There you will find Anointed Mummies and Anointed Skeletons. The Mummies debuff Str, while the Skeletons drain mana. After the first room, go right and follow the hallway towards another room. To the left, you should con High Priest Vorin, Construct of Vorin and Servant of Vorin. Approach the throne and receive a pop-up. If at all possible, again attempt to avoid High Priest Vorin as he cons red to a 55.

The pop-up instructs you to find Explorer Graeven.
1) BUT, Explorer Graevan is a RARE spawn. He's gonna get you to find a Legacy book (rare drop), then you have to talk to him again, so it's best to farm the book first in Chardith's city, then find Explorer Graevan, talk to him, then talk to him again and turn in the item. This way you only have to wait for a rare to spawn once not twice.
2) He instructs you to search for the Legacy of Averyth which randomly drops off mobs throughout Takish Hiz (note: This is a departure from rumors that said the Legacy only dropped from sunstars, star knights, and moon wraiths in Chardith's dungeon - the item does NOT drop exclusively from them). It dropped twice for CS off of Cinder Cats.

Note on where to find Explorer Graeven: He can be found roaming in the desert just outside the city at dusk in Takish Hiz NE E N (most commonly in the NE section).
CS found Explorer Graeven in the lb Truearrow camp (with the 3 tents and a campfire) to the East of the pointy mtn in the NE part of the zone. Graeven walked around the truearrow campsite south of the fire between the rock and the tree. Most posts say he can be found at dusk, which is 20 min past the hour. CS found that he spawned in the Truearrow camp at 15 min past the hour. Good luck.

You must find Graeven again to turn in the Legacy. Note that when you do find him, you must finish talking to him and advance your quest before he despawns, so don't waste time reading a whole lot.

Return to the tower in Envar SE and kill the Servant of Vorin. After killing it, another NPC will appear.

The NPC instructs you to search the libraries of Envar for info on Jal Raeth in the towers in Envar NE and SW. In the SW tower, the mob you seek is the Jal Raeth Librarian and has a placeholder in the first room on the left. The placeholder is a Jal Raeth Commoner which respawns every 30 minutes.

Take the book back to Kradesh Du' Klot in Freeport.

Du' Klot instructs you to go to Deadhills West, and back to the ruined lizardman towers.

After you have walked into the tower, three Jal Reath Librarians spawn. After speaking with them, they attack. They con dark blue to a 55 and have necro pets as well as life taps. Each mob drops a group portal charge gem with one charge.

The gem can then be used to teleport a group to the top of the middle tower in Envar. There, you will receive a pop-up which spawns the Jal Raeth Chancellor. He cons yellow to a 55, has a very strong mana drain, medium nukes, and has the ability to restore all his HP when he is down to half his original life. Once you've defeated him, he turns into a NPC.

He then instructs you to speak with the Chancellor's Servant in Deadhills W (at the lizardman ruins). There, you receive your reward.

Quest Reward - 45 Million XP and Class specific item, below.

In addition to the rewards listed below, Necs, Druids, and Wizards also get a Dead Hills Group Port (Astral Displacement) spell.

quests.guide:
**Quest NPC:** Prophet of Kumaj  
**Location:** Kerra Isle (SE) on rune hill near big white arches/bones


Begin the quest by talking to the Prophet of Kumaj located in Kerra Isle SE.

In an attempt to foster peace between the Kerra and Arcadians, the Prophet seeks your help in the construction of a totem of good will. He asks you to seek out 3 mobs in order to construct it. The mobs you seek are:

An Elder Elephant which can be found roaming around Sylhilthis' Dwell SE or C. Try near the Kappa Warrior Tents located in C, or further south. It cons yellow to a 53 and is not difficult to solo.

An Ancient Deepmare which can be found in Sylhilthis' Dwell NE. Head NE from the Kappa Citadel and search for it in the surrounding waters. It hits harder than the elephant, but can also be soloed.

An Ancient Swampfire Cobra, which can be found roaming around South Toxxulia NE N NW. The Cobra is the most difficult of the three. It has a nasty poison DoT and has very high AC. If you plan to solo it, make sure to have a healer, or max your PR.

Return the three items to the Prophet. He then informs you to seek out an NPC in Arcadin or Stone of Morthalis (Advisor Kellum) depending on which alignment you are. You then must return to the Prophet.

This time, you must speak to either General Talya in Arcadin or Slave Trader Dunbarr in Morthalis about the kerran slaves.

They inform you to return to them with a Gargoyle statue which drops off a Statue Guardian inside the gargoyle fortress. Inside the first main room, the guardian spawns in the back left corner. You will have to kill a roaming guard, keep the room clear, and farm the placeholder to get the guardian to spawn. A good thing to do with a group, but not impossible to do solo.

Return to the NPC in Arc or SoM. They will then send you back to the Prophet. The Prophet now requires the beads from two Kerran Shamen. One can be located in The Hunt C or N. He is typically found in the small valley surrounded by Ancient Manticores. Go to the north/south border of The Hunt and Abysmal Sea and con for him there. The second Shaman can be found roaming in West Toxxulia E, C or N, close to the river.

Return to the Prophet with the beads. He then informs you to purchase a piece of Yellow Marble from a stonemason in your aligned city. It costs 7004 tunar.

The final mob the Prophet asks you to seek is a Ty'Rizeth SoulCaller, which can be found in the underground lair in South Barren Coast (C). If you port there, the lair can be found directly north (and a point west), a 2 min run from port spot. The mob can be located in a room deep with in the lair. The SoulCaller is not difficult, however he is well protected. Be cautious of the Ty'Rizeth Gaurdians and if at all possible, bring assistance during this last part of the quest. For a detailed map of the Ty'Rizeth Santuary, go here.

Return to the Prophet for your reward.

quests.guide:
**Quest NPC:** Minastickie  
**Location:** Lavastorm


Begin the quest by speaking with Minastickie in Lavastorm (SE). To get there, coach to Klick'Anon, from coach, run out the west gate, follow mountains to the west. Soon you will see a shelter of sorts; there is a waysender there, talk to him. Minastickie is in a hut to your right.

She tells you she's found a paper which she believes is part of a map to a powerful scepter. To learn more, she asks you to visit Professer Cyrk in Freeport.

Cyrk can be found by the mages guild, past the archway. He says that he cannot read the paper because his glasses are broken and to fix them, he needs the sand from a Sand Wasp, found in South Barren Coast (C) (E) or (NE). They con yellow to a 53 and are not difficult to kill. However, their spawn time is approx: 1-3 hours. After returning the sandy carapace to Cyrk he confirms Mina's belief. He then sends you back to Minastickie who tells you there have been a number of strange sabotages lately and asks you to visit Exploring Aid Mixxa in Klick'Anon to learn more.

Exploring Aid Mixxa is located close to the bridge in the entrance of Klick'Anon. He asks you to defeat an Ancient Eel, in the sea in Rogue Clockworks (SE).

Ancient Eel (CONs yellow to a 53), which are found in Rogue Clockworks (SE) just off the coast. Find the Clockworks Village, and head straight EAST. On the coast, you will see a small island, swim from island east till you reach the end of the zone, the eel spawns north and south around this area. Beware, the eel has poison, and is under CON'd. Long spawn. Return what the eel drops to Mixxa, she returns you back to Minastickie, and she returns you back to the Professor.

The Professor is still having trouble reading a section of the map and needs two items to make it clearer:
A) Cleaning solution from a merchant (7100 tunar) in Hagley, he is near a well in the NW part of town.
B) Venom sack from a Swampfire Cobra (CONs yellow to 53) in South Toxxula(N),(NW). The mobs have a nasty Pr DoT, are resistant to magic and have high Ac. Keep killing till venom sacs drops.
Return to Professor.

The partially restored map reveals the location of another portion of the lost map. That piece, the Professor says, can be found in Yavreh's Sanctuary. He now sends you to kill Ty'Rizeth Scout (CONs Yellow to 53) at Yavreh's Sanctuary, South Barren Coast (map)(C ), in the underground temple. The Ty'Rizeth (CONs yellow to 53) mobs casts fire. You get a popup as you approach the entrance. Kill all mobs as you encounter them, no loot. Once inside, you will get another popup. Near this area, where you got the popup, is a room where the Scout will spawn. The placeholder is the one in the middle of the room(the Artisan); just keep killing the placeholder to spawn the Scout. Kill all mobs in the room and keep them fresh. Long spawn. Return to Professor

Cyrk restores the missing map piece and informs you that he knows where the final two pieces of the map can be found. The first is back in Yavreh's Sanctuary. The second is in Geomancer's Citadel.

Professor wants two items again;
A) He sends you back in Yavreh's Sanctuary to kill a Ty'Rizeth Scavenger (CONs yellow to 53). The Scavenger is NW from the room you killed the Scout (map). Invis and head towards the bodyguards. You'll get a popup near the entrance to the correct room. Inside the room, you will get another popup, kill all of the mobs in this room but leave them unlooted. The placeholder for the Scavenger is a Guardian towards the back of the room, and inside that fenced off area in a corner! Keep killing till spawn. Long spawn.
B) The second kill is an Ancient Drudge (CONs yellow to a 53) (has a heal too) is in Geomancer's Citadel (C ). To get there, the BEST way is to run west from Sphinx Pyramid, thru Lake Rathe, once in Geomancer's Pass, stay on the mountainsides as much as you can to avoid nasties. Keep heading west to coast. Now, follow coast North to Geomancer's Citadel. Undead nukes work well against the Ancient Drudge. Return to the Professor with both parts of the map.

Professor gives you the map and a note for Minastickie.

Minastickie gives you your reward. Done.
